notes.title: Cliff Rockslide Takes the Show on the Road (Well, Consoles)!
notes.content:
Attention, cameracrew! Big news from Butterfly Valley's favorite (and pretty much the only) newsman, Cliff Rockslide! Local News is breaking out of the streaming scene and landing on new consoles – that's right, PlayStation and Xbox! Mark your calendars for June 28th, because Cliff's quirky brand of journalism is about to take the world by storm.

So dust off your microphones, hire your cameraperson, and get ready to hit the streets of Butterfly Valley! Remember folks: local news is global news!

[b]Local News with Cliff Rockslide will be available on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One and Xbox Series S/X starting June 28th.[/b]

Check out the new PlayStation and Xbox trailer

notes.title: Local News with Cliff Rockslide is released
notes.content:
Step into the Zany World of Journalism with "Local News with Cliff Rockslide" - Now Available on Steam!

August 7th, 2023, Arctic Circle, Finland - Get ready for an uproarious adventure in the quirky town of Butterfly Valley, as "Local News with Cliff Rockslide" launches on Steam! Developed by Horsefly Games, this first-person visual novel promises laughter, chaos, and heartwarming moments as players take on the role of a cameraperson for the town's renowned influencer, Cliff Rockslide.

[previewyoutube=0WXxNJKMD9Y;full][/previewyoutube]

"Local News with Cliff Rockslide" introduces players to the lovable and eccentric Cliff Rockslide, a beloved news reporter whose small town of Butterfly Valley may seem ordinary at first glance. However, as players delve deeper into the charmingly offbeat story, they'll discover that this seemingly unremarkable town is hiding an abundance of hilariously outrageous and unexpected events.

[b]Key Features:
[/b][list]
[*] Hilarious and Heartwarming Tale: Immerse yourself in a delightfully funny and endearing narrative crafted by one of Finland's top comedians, blending country-side comedy with a touch of the absurd.

[*] Point-and-Shoot Adventure: Assume the role of a freshly-hired cameraperson for Cliff Rockslide and capture every wild moment with your camera's lens, framing shots like a professional to make Cliff famous.
 
[*] A Fusion of Genres: Experience a unique blend of point-and-click gameplay, visual novel storytelling, and first-person perspective, offering a fresh and engaging gaming experience.
 
[*] Unravel Mysteries and Solve Puzzles: Engage in fun minigames, complete challenges, and solve puzzles as you follow Cliff Rockslide on his adventurous and unpredictable escapades.
[/list]

"Local News with Cliff Rockslide" invites players to explore a world where zombies, cults, and mysterious cubes converge in a hilarious and heartwarming manner. Whether it's documenting intense action or witnessing the absurdity of Butterfly Valley, every moment captured on camera contributes to this unforgettable journey.

Embark on an extraordinary visual novel experience filled with humor, charm, and surprises in "Local News with Cliff Rockslide" 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2464030/Local_News_with_Cliff_Rockslide/
